Container.Name: manabrew-web
Container.Overview: Manabrew browser client (static app served by Caddy on :80), preconfigured to connect to your relay. Must be served over HTTPS (reverse proxy on e.g. play.example.com): the WASM engine needs SharedArrayBuffer, which browsers only allow in a secure, cross-origin-isolated page. Your proxy must pass through the Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy / Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy headers this container sends. Plain http://UNRAID-IP will load but games won't start.
Container.Requires: manabrew-relay, plus a reverse proxy with TLS for both the web and relay hostnames.

Config.Name: HTTP port
Config.Description: Container serves plain HTTP on 80. Map to any free host port and point your reverse proxy's play hostname at it.

Config.Name: Relay host
Config.Description: PUBLIC hostname browsers use to reach your relay, e.g. relay.example.com. This is resolved by your friends' browsers, not by this container, so don't use a container name or LAN IP. Empty = official relay.manabrew.app.

Config.Name: Relay port
Config.Description: 443 = wss:// (behind your TLS proxy, recommended). Any other port = plain ws://, which an HTTPS page can't open (mixed content).

Config.Name: Relay password
Config.Description: Set to MANABREW_SERVER_KEY once this hostname is behind an NPM Access List: it's written in plain text into /config.js. Browser Forge 'Play vs AI' always uses this built-in key (not the one typed in Settings), so leaving it empty breaks that feature. Without an Access List, leave empty and friends paste the key into Settings - Server.

Config.Name: Hosted AI (Forge)
Config.Description: true = show the Forge 'Play vs AI' option in the browser, which runs on a manabrew-node room. Needs manabrew-node. The basic in-browser AI works without this.

Config.Name: Forge in browser
Config.Description: true = a browser player's own tab runs Forge for the multiplayer Forge tables they create, instead of claiming a node room. Automatic for supported browsers (no Settings toggle): 72 MB download plus one trial game the first time, with fallback to the node. Doesn't affect Forge 'Play vs AI' or desktop players. Keep false with manabrew-node: a browser-hosted table ends if the host closes their tab.
